validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real and well documented. The Iran-Armenia gas pipeline was inaugurated 19 March/April 2007 (Presidents Ahmadinejad + Kocharyan) at the Armenian border village of Agarak and began commercial gas flow ~2009. Corroborated by two independent origins: Global Trade Review (gtreview.com, contemporaneous 2007 report — 141 km, 100 km inside Iran, opened at Agarak, operator ArmRosGazprom) and Jamestown Foundation (jamestown.org — 140 km, Tabriz->border, Meghri->Kajaran, 700 mm, Gazprom control). GulfPub PE World Map independently carries it as 'Iran - Armenia | Operating | International | Tabriz -> Ararat | NIOC dia=30in(=762mm~700mm)' (its len_km=87 is the 87-MILE figure mis-unit-ed, i.e. the same 140 km). The sheet's own current Status ref (Jamestown) resolves 200 but the literal token 'operating' is not on the page (expected — it is a narrative source); status=operating is nonetheless confirmed by the flow history above. CLASSIFICATION: correctly gas transmission (international export trunk), not gathering/process/oil/condensate; PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas confirmed. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 31-row Iran-gas operating roster and the GulfPub Iran roster — no duplicate. The nearby GulfPub 'Astara - Tabriz' (Astara->Tabriz, 30in, 172 km) is a DIFFERENT line (the Iranian domestic feeder from the Astara border), not this Tabriz->Armenia export line; do not merge.

validity.recommendation: Correct EndLocation: replace the uncorroborated 'Sardarian' with the real terminus — Kajaran (first/operating phase, ~40 km inside Armenia) or Ararat (2008 extension). Keep StartLocation=Tabriz.
validity.researcher_notes: ENDPOINT PROBLEM. The sheet has Start=Tabriz, Iran (corroborated: Jamestown states the ~100 km Iranian section runs from Tabriz to the border) and End='Sardarian', Armenia. 'Sardarian' does not appear in ANY independent source — a web search surfaces it ONLY on GEM/dbpedia mirrors, which means the sheet is citing itself. Independent sources agree the Armenian terminus is Meghri/Agarak at the border, then Kajaran (phase 1, inaugurated 2007, ~40 km) with a planned/2008 extension to Ararat (Jamestown: 'Meghri region to Kajaran'; GTR: opened at Agarak; GulfPub: Tabriz->Ararat). 'Sardarian' looks like an unverifiable/garbled place name and should be replaced. This is a lesser (attribution) caveat, not an existence doubt.

validity.recommendation: Re-examine SegmentCost=$370M — it is uncorroborated; the contemporaneous independent figure is US$200M. Also note Capacity=222.5 MMcf/d is the design/ultimate figure (~2.3 bcm/yr), not actual throughput.
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC CHECK vs GEM values. LENGTH 141 km = HIGH confidence: GTR states '141km pipeline' verbatim (exact match) and Jamestown states 140 km — two independent origins agree. DIAMETER 700 mm = confirmed by Jamestown (reduced from 1,420 to 700 mm under Gazprom pressure); single strong independent -> medium. CAPACITY 222.5 MMcf/d = ~2.3 bcm/yr, which matches the DESIGN/ultimate capacity (GTR: initial 450 mn m3/yr rising to 2.3 bn m3/yr; Jamestown notes actual current export ~365 mn m3/yr = ~1 mn m3/day). So the number is a defensible design capacity but is NOT the actual flow — medium. START YEAR 2007 confirmed (GTR: inaugurated 19 April 2007; broadly reported). COST CONFLICT: sheet says SegmentCost=US$370,000,000; the independent contemporaneous GTR report says 'US$200mn pipeline'. $370M is not corroborated by any independent source I found; leaving it unverified and flagging as a spec disagreement (do NOT silently pass).

fills.researcher_notes: GTR states '141km pipeline' verbatim (exact match to GEM 141.00); Jamestown states 140 km. Two independent origins. Replaces the existing Jamestown-only Length ref, whose page does not contain the token '141'.

Jamestown: diameter reduced 'from 1,420 to 700 millimetres (56 to 28 in)'. Token '700' verified on page. GulfPub independently gives 30 in (762 mm ~ 700 mm), so consistent; single strong independent narrative -> medium.

222.5 MMcf/d ~= 2.3 bcm/yr, matching the pipeline's design/ultimate capacity. GTR: initial 450 mn m3/yr rising to 2.3 bn m3/yr ('2.3' verified on page). Jamestown notes actual current export ~365 mn m3/yr. Number reflects design, not actual flow -> medium; ref pairs to the stated design figure.

GTR reports the pipeline was opened/inaugurated 19 April 2007 ('2007' verified on page); Jamestown notes commercial gas flow began ~2009. StartYear1=2007 reflects the inauguration. Single strong contemporaneous independent source -> medium.

Ref supports StartLocation=Tabriz (Jamestown: Iranian section runs from Tabriz; token 'Kajaran'/'Meghri' verified) and the Armenian corridor (GTR: opened at Agarak on the border). IMPORTANT: the ref does NOT support EndLocation='Sardarian' — that value is uncorroborated (see attribution validity finding) and should be changed to Kajaran/Ararat. Filling the Location ref for the corroborated start + corridor only.

Ownership is split by section. Armenian section: Jamestown states Gazprom holds a majority via its subsidiary Gazprom Armenia (token 'Gazprom' verified); GTR (2007) gives ArmRosGazprom = Gazprom 57.6% / Armenian govt 34.7% / Itera 7.7% (token 'ArmRosGazprom' verified). So Owner2='Gazprom PJSC' is well supported. Owner1='Iran Ministry of Petroleum' for the Iranian state section is plausible but not explicitly named in these sources (GulfPub attributes operation to NIOC); medium. Consider whether the Iranian owner should be NIGC/NIOC rather than the Ministry.

Could NOT corroborate SegmentCost=US$370M. The contemporaneous independent GTR report describes it as a 'US$200mn pipeline'. No independent source supports $370M. Leaving the ref blank and flagging the value as a spec disagreement (see spec validity finding); do not auto-apply a fabricated ref to a number I cannot confirm.

routes.corridor_desc: The line runs from the Tabriz area of Iran's East Azerbaijan province ~100 km north to the Aras (Araxes) river border, crossing into Armenia at Agarak near Meghri. It then climbs north through the mountainous Syunik corridor (Meghri -> Kajaran, ~40 km, the 2007 operating first phase). A 2008 extension carries it further north toward Ararat and the Armenian distribution grid. Endpoints are named-town precision; the exact mountain routing between them is not published, so treat the between-town alignment as approximate (corridor bound is tight at the towns, looser in between). Coordinates are standard coordinates of the named towns/crossing, not surveyed pipeline vertices.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources: Jamestown ('Iranian section runs from Tabriz to the border; Armenian section runs from the Meghri region to Kajaran' — tokens Kajaran/Meghri verified) and GTR (opened at Agarak on the Iranian border; 100 km inside Iran; extension toward central Armenia). The current sheet endpoints start='Asia'/end='Asia' are placeholders and clearly wrong; the sheet's EndLocation 'Sardarian' is uncorroborated and replaced here by Kajaran (operating terminus). Lat/lon are the published coordinates of each named town/crossing; no coordinate was invented and no route-repo geometry was touched. This is a corridor SUGGESTION for a later human routes-repo branch.
